name: Karan Boutique
description: Ladies' tailoring boutique in Tehsilpura, Amritsar. Bring your fabric and we stitch Patiala, Anarkali, Sharara, Gharara, straight-cut and palazzo suits to your measurements, and do alterations.
whatsappGreeting: Hi Karan Boutique, I want to get a suit stitched.
homeService: We don't do home measurement. Once we have your measurements, we can pick up your fabric and send back your finished suit by Uber parcel. You pay the delivery cost.
urgentOrders: [Yes, for an extra charge. Message us to check the date.]
otherOutfits: [Tell us if you also stitch blouses, lehengas or kids' clothes]
